candidates.source: static/fonts/NotoSans-Regular.ttf (in repo, already in production use)
candidates.licence_evidence: static/fonts/OFL.txt — "Copyright 2022 The Noto Project Authors", full OFL 1.1 text committed alongside the binaries
candidates.owner_permission: GRANTED — OFL permits commercial use, embedding and outlining; artwork is a DOCUMENT, not a Modified Version
candidates.reference_compatibility: PARTIAL — Noto Sans is a neutral humanist sans. The reference supporting line reads as a lighter, more geometric sans. Weight, case, rhythm and scale match; the underlying skeleton is not an exact stylistic match.
REJECTED — a Didone display face; wrong register for discreet supporting copy

candidates.family: Futura BT / Jost / Montserrat and 1,008 others
candidates.licence_evidence: NONE — the directory contains 1,011 font files and ZERO licence, EULA or readme documents
candidates.reference_compatibility: Several would be better stylistic matches (narrow / geometric sans).
candidates.rejection_reason: Licence is never inferred from a family name and possession is not permission. Futura BT in particular is a commercial Bitstream face. Without licence evidence none of these may be used in artwork.

authority_basis: the face is explicitly identified, its licence evidence is committed in-repo, the binary is complete rather than an extracted subset, and the licence permits this use
open_stylistic_finding: VQ2_SUPPORTING_COPY_FACE_NOT_IDEAL_STYLISTIC_MATCH — resolving this needs a licensed narrow or geometric sans to be acquired or an existing one to be licence-evidenced. That is an acquisition decision, not something I can settle from what is in the repo.
